page.overview:
Who is Mayanka Catrine?

Mayanka Catrine was a Jedi who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Catrine and her Padawan, Agustin, encountered Asajj Ventress at the Outpost 716. Catrine engaged Ventress in a lightsaber duel and successfully captured her with the aid of Agustin. However, when Catrine and her Padawan left on a mission, Ventress was able to overtake the outpost once Catrine had left. Catrine wielded a blue lightsaber while in combat, and wore brown Jedi robes.
